Subdomain header allowlist entries must be valid HTTP header names

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
begin
  engine_config = { 'subdomain_header_allowlist' => ['invalid header name'] }
  engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
  url = 'https://example.com'
  result = Crawlberg.scrape(engine, url)
rescue StandardError => error
  warn "#{error.class}: #{error.message}"
end
```
